name: ozioma/otp
description: Framework-independent one-time password generation and verification for PHP, with optional Laravel integration.

suggest.laravel/framework: Required only when using the optional Laravel integration (Laravel 11, 12 or 13).
suggest.ext-pdo: Required only when using the supplied PDO storage adapters.
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required when using the PDO adapter with MySQL.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required when using the PDO adapter with PostgreSQL.
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Required when using the PDO adapter with SQLite.
